issues.text: TotalDocs() walks b.cache without a lock, and the new call site added in this change sits right after a watch goroutine is started.
issues.zh: TotalDocs() 無鎖走訪 b.cache，而本次新增的呼叫點就緊接在 watch goroutine 啟動之後

issues.text: Now that cacheMu only wraps the map write, BuildIndex calls for the same key are no longer serialized.
issues.zh: cacheMu 縮到只包住 map 寫入之後，同一個 key 的 BuildIndex 失去序列化

issues.text: NewResourceServer's error path never calls cancel() and doesn't reclaim the goroutines and indexes Init already started.
issues.zh: NewResourceServer 的錯誤路徑沒有呼叫 cancel()，也沒有回收 Init 已經啟動的 goroutine 與索引

issues.text: NewResourceServer has no context parameter, so the index building moved into construction can't be canceled or bounded.
issues.zh: NewResourceServer 沒有 context 參數，搬進建構期的索引建置因此無法取消也無法設上限

issues.text: The PR's only test change is disabling the postgres integration test, which is exactly what covers the startup path this PR changes.
issues.zh: 本 PR 唯一的測試變更是把 postgres 整合測試停掉，而它覆蓋的正是本 PR 改動的啟動路徑

issues.text: The same initialization error is logged twice with an identical message string.
issues.zh: 同一個初始化錯誤被記錄兩次，訊息字串完全相同

issues.text: This PR's trace context fix isn't applied to bleve.BuildIndex, so that span can't pick up child spans.
issues.zh: 本 PR 的 trace context 修正沒有套到 bleve.BuildIndex，那段 span 因此接不到子節點

issues.text: The 'issue a health check to force server initialization' trick in watcher_test.go no longer works, and the comment is now stale.
issues.zh: watcher_test.go 裡「發一次 health check 讓 server 完成初始化」的做法已經失效，註解也隨之過時

open_questions.text: Why does TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer only fail on postgres in Drone? Is it caused by this PR's startup timing change, or by differences in the postgres environment itself?
open_questions.zh: postgres 上的 TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer 究竟為什麼只在 Drone 失敗？是本 PR 的啟動時序改變造成的，還是 postgres 環境本身的差異？

open_questions.text: On a Grafana instance with real data volume, after moving full index building into NewResourceServer, will startup time exceed dskit's module startup tolerance or create a noticeably longer unavailable period for users?
open_questions.zh: 在一個有實際資料量的 Grafana 實例上，把全量索引建置搬到 NewResourceServer 之後，啟動時間是否會超過 dskit 模組的啟動容忍度，或讓使用者看到明顯變長的無服務期間？

open_questions.text: With initWatcher moved to after search.init, could events written during index building be missed?
open_questions.zh: 把 initWatcher 移到 search.init 之後（server.go:303-311），對於索引建置期間寫入的事件是否會造成遺漏？
